resources.string: No \'Display over other apps\' permission. Connect Shizuku and GOAT will grant it.
Hiding the status bar requires Shizuku. Without it, the keyboard won\'t appear in other apps while hidden.
Stays hidden even after you go back. Shown while the keyboard is open
GOAT Status Bar Hiding Input Helper
GOAT: While the status bar is hidden, makes the keyboard appear right away when you tap a text field. Only checks whether the tapped spot is a text field and never reads screen content.
